purpose: Simulate ordinary broken-chair warranty conversations and diverse real shopping/service inquiries, as clarified by the user.
rules: Keep application code unchanged and preserve previous audit results.
Use real isolated public HTTP APIs and record customer requests, actual reply payloads, and saved state.
Honor documented confirmation-before-advance rules: suggesting the right branch and asking confirmation is valid.
A useful clarification or correct handoff is valid when facts or authorization are genuinely missing; do not require fabricated answers.
Judge customer-visible answers, retained facts, correct department and relevant next steps; HTTP200 alone is insufficient.
Do not treat ordinary malfunction intake as automatic warranty approval.
Distinguish symptom reports from pre-purchase feature questions and delivery-policy questions from installation problems.
Preserve failed full transcripts and expected customer goals; no application fixes or weakened expectations to improve the result.
Treat missing-model and provider-unavailable conditions as tested fallback capabilities, not measurements of a live LLM.
No real external calls, notifications or production customer data.
Report category pass counts rather than inventing customer-frequency weights or a new universal score.
Real model accuracy, naturalness, live store data and real customer resolution remain unmeasured.
